# #061 hidden portfolio-mode dispatcher; every failure restores the original card.
zg361cp.9261 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	trigger = { is_ai = no }
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				exists = scope:zg361_cp_i_owner
				exists = scope:zg361_cp_i_subject
				exists = scope:zg361_cp_i_cycle
				exists = scope:zg361_cp_i_case
				this = scope:zg361_cp_i_owner
				zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
				scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
					zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_i_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_i_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_i_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_i_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_i_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_i_active
						EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_i_owner
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_i_subject
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_i_cycle
						EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_i_case
						EXPECTED_STATE = 1
					}
				}
				scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
					has_variable = zg361_cp_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode >= 1
					var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode <= 3
				}
			}
			scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
				zg361_cp_clear_pending_player_event_effect = { EVENT = 9261 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = { var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode = 1 } }
				scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
					zg361_cp_m61_route_a_effect = {
						TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_i_owner
						TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_i_subject
						TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_i_cycle
						TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_i_case
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = { var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode = 2 } }
				scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
					zg361_cp_m61_route_b_effect = {
						TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_i_owner
						TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_i_subject
						TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_i_cycle
						TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_i_case
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = { var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode = 3 } }
				scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
					zg361_cp_m61_route_c_effect = {
						TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_i_owner
						TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_i_subject
						TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_i_cycle
						TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_i_case
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = {
						trigger_if = {
							limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_runtime_applied }
							var:zg361_cp_runtime_applied = 1
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					}
				}
				scope:zg361_cp_i_subject = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_pending_player_event value = 54 } }
				trigger_event = { id = zg361cp.54 days = 1 }
			}
			else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361cp.61 } }
		}
		else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361cp.61 } }
	}
}
